subject: Re: 🔵{Brand} & MobUpps
body:
Hi RECIPIENT_NAME,
Following up on my note about driving completed bookings for your travel app rather than just installs. The one point worth repeating: we optimize to a validated completed booking with a booking ID and revenue, and we net out cancellations and no-shows before we count it, so the volume you pay for at roughly $14 per validated booking is clean. If it helps, I can pull the route-level booking view for your live markets. Worth a quick look?
angle: warm bump, restate validated completed-booking proof
register_notes: Stage 1 EN travel_and_booking: references prior outreach in first sentence; restates single proof (validated completed booking with booking ID + revenue, net of cancellations); one illustrative figure (~$14 per validated booking); soft CTA, 1 question mark; native US English; no sign-off; no X-not-Y.
